name: After a Tricky Bug
description: Eight questions for looking back after a stubborn problem, with optional notes that stay on this device.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight questions for looking back after a hard bug, shown on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Look back as far as feels useful.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and think about the problem you just solved.
If you like, type a few words in the notes box. They stay on this device.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
tips: Keep notes free of secrets and private details. Clear them any time.
